_comment: Logical BMS bus -> physical CAN channel mapping.
Edit the 'channel' values to match how the bench is wired today. A PCAN-USB channel
is physically attached to exactly one bus, so only the buses selected with --bus are
expected to be live in a given run. Buses that are not selected are reported as
'not selected' and any test needing them is SKIPPED, never failed.
Use --can0/--can1/--can2/--can5 to override a single entry for one run, e.g.
